decisions.reason: As a flagship 2023 launch that remained promoted in 2024 and fits the firm's core organic dairy capabilities and strategic direction, it is likely performing at or above aspiration and worth retaining.

This 2024 mild sliced cheese is close to the established cheese business, and in a growing market a broad-range firm with some slack would usually keep such a new core-adjacent product unless early results clearly disappointed.

This 2024 sliced butter cheese also matches the firm's existing cheesemaking strengths, so under bounded rationality and with no clear sign of failure the firm is more likely to continue testing it than to withdraw it quickly.
